data.purpose: Pricing model for motor claims frequency
data.scope_and_use: The model is used to support pricing decisions based on the frequency of motor claims, specifically designed to be integrated into the pricing engine outputs.
data.data: The model utilizes data from insuranceData::dataCar, which includes vehicle insurance data for 67,856 policies.
data.methodology: The model employs a Poisson Generalized Linear Model (GLM) with a log(exposure) offset to predict the frequency of motor claims.
data.variables: The model includes the following features: veh_body, veh_age, agecat, area, and gender.
data.implementation: The model is implemented in the script pr001_claims_freq.R and produces outputs written to pr001_freq.csv.
data.governance: The model is owned by Pricing Analytics and is classified as Tier B, supporting decisions based on pricing engine outputs.
data.gaps: Assumptions and limitations of the model are not documented. Performance and monitoring strategies are also not documented. Additionally, the model has a policy-rule hit for using a protected characteristic (gender) as an input.
